candidate.answerReason: The opposite side is 2 sin 30° = 2 × 1/2 = 1, agreeing with the half-hypotenuse property.

methods.label: Sine ratio
methods.explanation: The opposite side equals the hypotenuse multiplied by the sine of the angle: \(2\times 1/2=1\).
methods.levelReason: Uses the right-triangle sine definition and the standard value sin 30° = 1/2.

methods.label: Thirty-degree right-triangle property
methods.explanation: In a right triangle, the side opposite a \(30^\circ\) angle is half the hypotenuse. The requested length is therefore \(\frac{2}{2}=1\).
methods.levelReason: Uses an earlier elementary geometry property directly, providing a route without trigonometric ratios.
